senses.gloss:
ल 1. ल, the twenty-eighth consonant of
the Nāgarī alphabet, being the semivowel of the
vowels ऌ, ॡ, and having the sound of the English
ल्.
—ल-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ल.
—ल-
कार-वाद, अस्, m., N. of a work.

ल 2. ल, Pāṇini's general or technical term
for all the tenses and moods or verbal terminations.
ल 3. ल, अस्, m., N. of Indra; cutting (?).
ल 4. ल (for लघु), a short syllable.

ला 1. ला, cl. 2. P. लाति, ललौ (3rd pl.
ललुः), &c., to take, receive, obtain.

2. ला, आस्, f. the act of taking, receiving; the
giving.
